poznamka: NAVRH bot7 pre bot16 (nic sa nenahrava). Uvod SK/EN po pridani druheho stolu (system 40). 'sk' = len ZMENENE kluce proti zivemu sk.json (home.lead, home.usp2.t/d, faq.2.q/a); ostatne uvodne texty SK ostavaju. 'en' = KOMPLETNY blok uvodu pre EN (v en.json zatial chyba vacsina home.*/faq.*/alt.*; existujuce home.lead/home.cta sa prepisu). Fakty: rozsahy a prislusenstvo su rovnake pre oba systemy (api/stul_konfigurator.py), profil 30x30 drazka 8 mm, 40x40 drazka 10 mm. Bez nosnosti a materialu dosky, bez montaze (zatial nie je v SK/EN shope).

sk.home.lead: Baliace a pracovné stoly s rámom z hliníkových profilov 30 × 30 mm alebo 40 × 40 mm. Nastavte šírku, hĺbku a výšku, pridajte police a príslušenstvo a pozrite si výsledok v 3D. Ceny sú uvedené bez DPH.
sk.home.usp2.d: Rám je z hliníkových profilov v dvoch veľkostiach: 30 × 30 mm s drážkou 8 mm alebo robustnejší zo 40 × 40 mm s drážkou 10 mm. Drážky pozdĺž profilov umožňujú upraviť police a príslušenstvo.
sk.faq.2.q: Z čoho je rám stola a ako sa líšia oba stoly?
sk.faq.2.a: Z hliníkových profilov spojených rohovými spojkami. Jeden stôl má profily 30 × 30 mm s drážkou 8 mm, robustný stôl profily 40 × 40 mm s drážkou 10 mm. Rozmery a príslušenstvo si nastavíte rovnako. Drážky pozdĺž profilov umožňujú upraviť police a príslušenstvo.

en.home.h1: Packing tables and workbenches made to your size
en.home.lead: Packing tables and workbenches with an aluminium profile frame of 30 × 30 mm or 40 × 40 mm. Set the width, depth and height, add shelves and accessories and see the result in 3D. Prices are shown excl. VAT.
en.home.usp1.d: You set the worktop width, depth and height yourself. The width can be 500 to 3000 mm and the depth 400 to 1500 mm.
en.home.usp2.d: The frame is made of aluminium profiles in two sizes: 30 × 30 mm with an 8 mm slot or the more robust 40 × 40 mm with a 10 mm slot. The slots along the profiles allow shelves and accessories to be adjusted.
en.home.usp3.d: You rotate the table and see every change at once. A combination that cannot be made is refused by the system.
en.home.usp4.d: The table is made to order. We set the shipping price after the order.
en.home.extras: You can add castors, perforated tool panels, LED lighting, steel drawers, a power strip with sockets and a holder for a PET bottle. Cut-outs can be added to the worktop.
en.home.step1.d: Enter the dimensions, the number of shelves and the accessories. You see the result in 3D.
en.home.step2.d: The price is shown excl. VAT and changes with your configuration.
en.home.step3.t: 3. Add to cart and send the order
en.home.step3.d: You do not need to create an account. We send the proforma invoice including shipping by e-mail after the order is confirmed.
en.home.cta2.d: Set the dimensions and accessories and send your order. Prices are shown excl. VAT.
en.faq.1.q: Can I choose my own dimensions?
en.faq.1.a: Yes. You set the width (500 to 3000 mm), the depth (400 to 1500 mm) and the height of the worktop yourself. Above 1500 mm of width the table gets an additional middle leg at the front and at the back.
en.faq.2.q: What is the frame made of and how do the two tables differ?
en.faq.2.a: Aluminium profiles joined with corner connectors. One table has 30 × 30 mm profiles with an 8 mm slot, the robust table 40 × 40 mm profiles with a 10 mm slot. The dimensions and accessories are set in the same way. The slots along the profiles allow shelves and accessories to be adjusted.
en.faq.3.a: Castors, perforated tool panels, LED lighting, steel drawers, a power strip with sockets and a holder for a PET bottle. You can also add lower shelves (up to 10, depending on the height of the table) and cut-outs in the worktop. Panels and LED lighting need a table width of at least 1200 mm.
en.faq.4.q: What if I choose a combination that cannot be made?
en.faq.4.a: The system refuses it and shows the reason. Every valid configuration is a table that can really be made.
en.faq.5.a: The table is made to order. Delivery takes 3–5 weeks.
en.faq.6.q: Are prices with or without VAT?
en.faq.7.q: Do I need an account to order?
en.faq.7.a: No. You can send the order as a guest, without an account.
en.faq.8.q: How do payment and shipping work?
en.faq.8.a: Payment is in advance by bank transfer based on a proforma invoice. We set the shipping price after the order and confirm it before the proforma invoice is issued. The proforma invoice including shipping is sent by e-mail after the order is confirmed. The table is made after payment.
